notes.title: NEWS + Trading Cards + Bugfixes 🤎
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470810/bd079cd489e02eedb0660863abe24d14fb25a259.png[/img]

Greetings, dear readers!

Today, we have some good news for you! First of all, Coffee & Boobs is selling wonderfully, and at the moment, the game has sold more than 20,000 copies! It was a surprise to us that you liked our new game that much, and that's why we are already thinking about creating a DLC! Hope you'll be excited 🤎

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471590/Coffee__Boobs/

We’ve already released Steam Trading Cards based on our game — featuring 4 unique backgrounds, 5 interesting emojis, and a cozy icon ☕

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470810/ef5c3d08b3b42805025837758853539045ce315d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470810/f2ffdc7b73a2a99db236b37571c1d69e8cb71f68.jpg[/img]

[b]🎉 We've released a game update! Here's what we fixed and added:
[/b]

1. Full or partial censorship option ✂️
2. Fixed voice acting in several scenes 🎙️
3. Cleaned up the script — mostly typos and minor inaccuracies 📝
4. Fixed achievements and localization issues, especially after adding the censorship feature ✍️
5. Fixed a bug where one character’s legs were displayed incorrectly (everything is in place now) 👣
6. Added additional visual effects 💫
7. Now, when you hover over a UI button, you will hear a pleasant sound 🔊
8. Fixed a bug where bird chirping in the park continued after completing Chapter 1 🐦
9. And most importantly — Russian voiceover now works in all languages 🥳

[b]THANK YOU FOR STAYING WITH US! WE WOULD BE GLAD IF YOU ADD OUR OTHER GAMES TO YOUR WISHLIST:
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369140/SORREL_COFFEE/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/
